title.de: Verben des Sagens: suggested going, advised me to
title.sl: Glagoli poročanja: suggested going, advised me to
title.it: I verbi per riferire: suggested going, advised me to

goal.sl: Namesto said rabiš suggest, advise, warn, promise, admit, deny in refuse, vsakega s svojim vzorcem (He advised me to wait, Sam suggested going by bus).
goal.de: Statt said nimmst du suggest, advise, warn, promise, admit, deny und refuse, jedes mit seinem Muster (He advised me to wait, Sam suggested going by bus).
goal.it: Invece di said usi suggest, advise, warn, promise, admit, deny e refuse, ognuno col suo schema (He advised me to wait, Sam suggested going by bus).
goal.en: In place of said you can use suggest, advise, warn, promise, admit, deny and refuse, each with its pattern (He advised me to wait, Sam suggested going by bus).

say.sl: Namesto **said** povedo nekateri glagoli več. Po **promise, refuse, agree, offer** pride **to** + osnovna oblika: **Jack promised to come.** (Jack je obljubil, da bo prišel.) **Old Wilf refused to pay.** (Stari Wilf ni hotel plačati.) **Sam offered to help.** Z ne: **He promised not to tell.**
say.de: Statt **said** sagen manche Verben mehr. Nach **promise, refuse, agree, offer** kommt **to** + Grundform: **Jack promised to come.** (Jack hat versprochen zu kommen.) **Old Wilf refused to pay.** (Der alte Wilf hat sich geweigert zu zahlen.) **Sam offered to help.** Verneint: **He promised not to tell.**
say.it: Invece di **said** alcuni verbi dicono di più. Dopo **promise, refuse, agree, offer** viene **to** + forma base: **Jack promised to come.** (Jack ha promesso di venire.) **Old Wilf refused to pay.** (Il vecchio Wilf si è rifiutato di pagare.) **Sam offered to help.** Col no: **He promised not to tell.**
say.en: In place of **said** some verbs say more. After **promise, refuse, agree, offer** comes **to** + the base form: **Jack promised to come.** **Old Wilf refused to pay.** **Sam offered to help.** With no: **He promised not to tell.**

say.sl: Po **advise, warn, remind, tell** pride oseba, potem **to**: **He advised me to wait.** (Svetoval mi je, naj počakam.) **Edna reminded me to feed the hens.** Z ne je **not to**: **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.** Slovenščina reče *naj*, angleščina **to**.
say.de: Nach **advise, warn, remind, tell** kommt die Person, dann **to**: **He advised me to wait.** (Er hat mir geraten zu warten.) **Edna reminded me to feed the hens.** Verneint **not to**: **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.** Kein *dass*, die Person steht direkt nach dem Verb.
say.it: Dopo **advise, warn, remind, tell** viene la persona, poi **to**: **He advised me to wait.** (Mi ha consigliato di aspettare.) **Edna reminded me to feed the hens.** Col no **not to**: **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.** Niente *a*: la persona sta subito dopo il verbo.
say.en: After **advise, warn, remind, tell** comes the person, then **to**: **He advised me to wait.** **Edna reminded me to feed the hens.** With no it's **not to**: **Mrs Birkett warned us not to walk on the ice.**

say.sl: Po **suggest, admit, deny** pride **-ing**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** (Sam je predlagal, da gremo z avtobusom.) **Harry admitted taking the cake.** (Harry je priznal, da je vzel kolač.) **He denied taking the money.** Za preteklost lahko tudi **having**: **He denied having taken it.** Pri admit tudi **admitted to taking**.
say.de: Nach **suggest, admit, deny** kommt **-ing**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** (Sam hat vorgeschlagen, mit dem Bus zu fahren.) **Harry admitted taking the cake.** (Harry hat zugegeben, den Kuchen genommen zu haben.) **He denied taking the money.** Für die Vergangenheit auch **having**: **He denied having taken it.** Bei admit auch **admitted to taking**.
say.it: Dopo **suggest, admit, deny** viene **-ing**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** (Sam ha proposto di andare in autobus.) **Harry admitted taking the cake.** (Harry ha ammesso di aver preso la torta.) **He denied taking the money.** Per il passato anche **having**: **He denied having taken it.** Con admit anche **admitted to taking**.
say.en: After **suggest, admit, deny** comes **-ing**: **Sam suggested going by bus.** **Harry admitted taking the cake.** **He denied taking the money.** For the past **having** too: **He denied having taken it.** With admit also **admitted to taking**.

say.sl: Pri **suggest** pazi: slovensko *predlagal mi je, naj grem* ni me to go. Reci **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*) ali s stavkom: **Sam suggested that we go by bus.** **Sam suggested that we should go by bus.** Ni mu treba osebe.
say.de: Bei **suggest** aufpassen: *er schlug mir vor zu gehen* ist nicht me to go. Sag **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*) oder mit einem Satz: **Sam suggested that we go by bus.** **Sam suggested that we should go by bus.** Eine Person braucht es nicht.
say.it: Con **suggest** attenzione: *mi ha suggerito di andare* non è me to go. Di' **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*) o con una frase: **Sam suggested that we go by bus.** **Sam suggested that we should go by bus.** Non serve la persona.
say.en: Watch **suggest**: it takes no someone + to. Say **Sam suggested going by bus** (never *Sam suggested me to go*), or with a clause: **Sam suggested that we go by bus.** **Sam suggested that we should go by bus.**

say.sl: Večina teh glagolov vzame tudi **that** + stavek, s korakom nazaj kot po said: **He admitted that he had taken it.** (Priznal je, da ga je vzel.) **She denied that she knew him.** **Jack promised that he would come.** **Mrs Birkett warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** lahko odpade.
say.de: Die meisten dieser Verben nehmen auch **that** + Satz, ein Schritt zurück wie nach said: **He admitted that he had taken it.** (Er hat zugegeben, dass er es genommen hatte.) **She denied that she knew him.** **Jack promised that he would come.** **Mrs Birkett warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** kann wegfallen.
say.it: La maggior parte di questi verbi prende anche **that** + frase, un passo indietro come dopo said: **He admitted that he had taken it.** (Ha ammesso di averlo preso.) **She denied that she knew him.** **Jack promised that he would come.** **Mrs Birkett warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** può cadere.
say.en: Most of these verbs also take **that** + a clause, one step back as after said: **He admitted that he had taken it.** **She denied that she knew him.** **Jack promised that he would come.** **Mrs Birkett warned us that the ice was thin.** **that** can go.

say.sl: Za malo besedo vedno **-ing**: **She apologised for being late.** (Opravičila se je, ker je zamujala.) **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** (Gospod Tyson je vztrajal, da plača.) **Thank you for coming.** **They accused him of taking the money.** (Obtožili so ga, da je vzel denar.) Besedo se naučiš skupaj z glagolom.
say.de: Nach dem kleinen Wort immer **-ing**: **She apologised for being late.** (Sie hat sich für die Verspätung entschuldigt.) **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** (Mr Tyson hat darauf bestanden zu zahlen.) **Thank you for coming.** **They accused him of taking the money.** (Sie haben ihm vorgeworfen, das Geld genommen zu haben.) Das Wort lernst du mit dem Verb.
say.it: Dopo la parolina sempre **-ing**: **She apologised for being late.** (Si è scusata per il ritardo.) **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** (Mr Tyson ha insistito per pagare.) **Thank you for coming.** **They accused him of taking the money.** (Lo hanno accusato di aver preso i soldi.) La parolina si impara col verbo.
say.en: After the small word, always **-ing**: **She apologised for being late.** **Mr Tyson insisted on paying.** **Thank you for coming.** **They accused him of taking the money.** Learn the small word with the verb.

exercises.text: Sam's van broke down last night. Jack offered ___ (help). Mr Dixon advised Sam ___ (wait) until morning. Mrs Birkett suggested ___ (ring) the garage. Sam refused ___ (pay) for a new engine. He admitted ___ (forget) the oil. The man from the garage promised ___ (come) at nine.

accept: to help
to wait
ringing
to pay
forgetting
having forgotten
to come

translation.sl: Samu se je sinoči pokvaril kombi. Jack je ponudil pomoč. Gospod Dixon je Samu svetoval, naj počaka do jutra. Gospa Birkett je predlagala, da pokličejo mehanično delavnico. Sam ni hotel plačati novega motorja. Priznal je, da je pozabil na olje. Mož iz delavnice je obljubil, da pride ob devetih.
translation.de: Sams Lieferwagen hatte gestern Abend eine Panne. Jack hat angeboten zu helfen. Mr Dixon hat Sam geraten, bis zum Morgen zu warten. Mrs Birkett hat vorgeschlagen, die Werkstatt anzurufen. Sam hat sich geweigert, einen neuen Motor zu zahlen. Er hat zugegeben, das Öl vergessen zu haben. Der Mann von der Werkstatt hat versprochen, um neun zu kommen.
translation.it: Il furgone di Sam si è guastato ieri sera. Jack si è offerto di aiutare. Mr Dixon ha consigliato a Sam di aspettare fino al mattino. Mrs Birkett ha proposto di chiamare l'officina. Sam si è rifiutato di pagare un motore nuovo. Ha ammesso di aver dimenticato l'olio. L'uomo dell'officina ha promesso di venire alle nove.
translation.en: Sam's van broke down last night. Jack offered to help. Mr Dixon advised Sam to wait until morning. Mrs Birkett suggested ringing the garage. Sam refused to pay for a new engine. He admitted forgetting the oil. The man from the garage promised to come at nine.
